# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-08-01 06:11 UTC — [Pillar 3] SAGA clears carry but fails capacity as four depth rows reappear only on first print

**Task:** Refresh the extreme-funding universe after the zero-ready contraction and test whether any candidate simultaneously cleared persistence, hedgeability, capacity, and 24-hour fee recovery.
**Finding:** The candidate universe expanded 9→14 and raw hedgeable/OI-ready rows rebounded 0→4: TRUMP, VIRTUAL, AERO, and ONDO. All four are first-print reentries and all fail the 24-hour fee-only recovery gate, with recovery at 47.84, 59.74, 85.98, and 89.53 hours respectively, so confirmed-ready remains zero and no depth request is justified. SAGA produced the strongest persistent carry move, APR 46.691%→248.195% and recovery 54.41→10.24 hours, but OI rose only $1.931M→$1.957M, leaving it 60.9% below the $5M floor. ARB and FARTCOIN also moved toward the intersection, but ARB remains below capacity at $4.643M with 55.16-hour recovery, while FARTCOIN lacks an approved spot hedge and needs 51.49 hours. GRASS has $7.480M OI and the nearest non-SAGA recovery at 28.28 hours but also lacks an approved hedge. The prior W frontier disappeared after one scan. Timestamp-alignment controls passed stale and matched cases, all five APR-semantics cases passed, and zero depth requests were made.
**My thinking:** The persistence gate again separated a noisy opportunity-set rebound from an actionable intersection. SAGA's fivefold carry expansion is economically interesting but cannot compensate for missing capacity; conversely, the four capacity-qualified hedgeable rows lack both persistence and sufficient carry. The gates are identifying distinct failure modes rather than redundantly blocking the same rows.
**Decision:** Classify `CANDIDATES9_TO14 / RAW_READY0_TO4_TRUMP_VIRTUAL_AERO_ONDO / CONFIRMED0 / EXECUTABLE0 / ALL4_FIRST_PRINT_AND_RECOVERY_GT24H / TRUMP47P84H / VIRTUAL59P74H / AERO85P98H / ONDO89P53H / SAGA_APR46P691_TO248P195_RECOVERY54P41_TO10P24H_BUT_OI1P957M / ARB_OI4P643M_RECOVERY55P16H / FARTCOIN_OI19P164M_RECOVERY51P49H_NO_HEDGE / GRASS_OI7P480M_RECOVERY28P28H_NO_HEDGE / W_DROPPED_AFTER_ONE_SCAN / ALIGNMENT_STALE_AND_MATCHED_PASS / APR_SEMANTICS5_OF5 / DEPTH_REQUESTS0 / BLOCK_LIVE`. Keep approved-hedge, persistence, 29 bps fee, 24-hour recovery, 105.85% APR, $5M OI, spread, latency, basis, and borrow gates unchanged; make no execution, live-trading, or retired-bot change.
**Next:** Test whether SAGA can retain >105.85% APR while OI approaches $5M; require all four reentries to survive a second scan and cross the 24-hour recovery gate before collecting depth. Track two-scan survival of this four-row rebound and count the four depth requests avoided by the current gates.
